snippet.title: Flotsam 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Flotsam 1.0 is officially out now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/821250/Flotsam/

Build your floating town, explore the open ocean, and guide your drifters through a vibrant world made of garbage and hope.

After years of community support and development, Flotsam launches in its full 1.0 form with new regions, new specialists, new quests, and a polished city-building experience.

🌊 Build and grow your floating town
♻️ Recycle garbage into homes, workshops, and upgrades
🛶 Travel the flooded world and discover new regions
🐟 Rescue survivors and keep your community thriving
🧭 Experience the complete 1.0 adventure, available now

Play Flotsam on Steam: https://bit.ly/3Kag6r4
Join the community!
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/flotsam/
Discord: http://discord.gg/Flotsam
